results.description: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: Lok Bhavan issued a clarification following the controversy surrounding Governor Om Prakash Mathur’s decision to ban non-vegetarian food.

results.title: From cosmic scars to lava fields: 10 otherworldly landscapes to see in person
results.description: The surface of our planet is a living archive of violent celestial collisions, explosive volcanic events, and relentless tectonic forces. Across hundreds of millions of years, incoming space debris has gouged massive basins into continental crust and molten rock has cooled into geometric pillars. Here are 10 extraordinary geological wonders sculpted by Earth's most powerful natural forces.

results.title: Faf du Plessis Recalls Supporting Steve Smith During Ball Tampering
results.description: Faf du Plessis recalls supporting Steve Smith during the 2018 ball-tampering scandal, citing their shared experience with media pressure and acknowledging Smith's past defense of him during a similar controversy in 2016.

results.title: AISA President Neha Bora Slams Use of Peace Bonds to Curb Dissent
results.description: AISA president Neha Bora condemns the use of peace bonds against student protesters, calling them a weapon to suppress democratic dissent and violating constitutional rights to peaceful protest.

results.title: Jairam Ramesh Demands CEC Resignation Over Voter List Irregularity
results.description: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh has demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alleging that irregularities and bizarre entries in the Uttar Pradesh voter lists are part of a conspiracy to favor the BJP.

results.title: INDIA Bloc to Hold Mega Rally Demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar Resignation
results.description: The Congress and INDIA bloc will hold a nationwide mega rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1 to demand the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar amid ongoing protests against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.

results.title: PIL in Supreme Court Seeks Independent Oversight of Election Commission
results.description: A PIL in the Supreme Court seeks an expert committee to probe alleged ECI internal deficiencies and proposes a ban on the use of religious symbols and communal appeals by political parties and candidates during election campaigns.

results.title: Indian Karting Prodigy Atiqa Mir Shines at FIA World Cup Debut Event
results.description: 11-year-old Indian racing sensation Atiqa Mir impressed at her FIA Karting World Cup debut, finishing as the top female driver and showcasing elite potential with a strong performance against 117 international competitors in the junior category.
